Complete One Time Registration if you do not already have a TGPSC ID.
Open the online application link for Notification No. 04/OG/HM/2026.
Log in using the TGPSC ID, date of birth and OTP received on the registered mobile number.
Verify the personal, educational, category and other details fetched from the OTR database.
Preview the application and check every detail carefully.
Click the Save and Payment option and pay the applicable fee online.
Click Confirm and Submit to complete the application process.
Download the generated PDF application and retain its reference ID for future use.
important_instructions: OTR registration alone is not treated as an application for the post. Candidates must separately submit the online application for this notification. Only the details available in the OTR database at the time of application submission will be considered. Changes made to OTR after submitting the application will not apply to this recruitment. Incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected. Applications submitted through offline or any other mode will not be accepted. Candidates must download and preserve the final PDF application. Applicants must regularly check the TGPSC website for examination and recruitment updates.

rows.18_september_2026: Seven days before the examination until 5:00 PM on the previous day of the examination

content_sections.heading: TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notified vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease according to the requirements communicated by HMWSSB.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a graduate degree in Engineering in one of the prescribed branches as of 18 September 2026. The result of the required qualification must have been officially declared by the university on or before this date.

rows.engineering_branch: Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology or Electronics and Communication Engineering

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age of applicants will be calculated as of 1 July 2026.

content_sections.text: Employees of corporations and municipalities are not eligible for the age relaxation available to Telangana State Government employees.

rows.permissible_relaxation: Up to 5 years based on the length of regular service

3 years plus the length of service rendered in the NCC

content_sections.heading: TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates appointed as Manager (Engineering) will receive a pay scale of Rs. 54,220 to Rs. 1,33,630 .

content_sections.heading: Local Reservation
content_sections.text: The post is confined to Multi Zone II. Local reservation applies to 95% of the notified posts. Candidates belonging to other states may apply but are not entitled to Telangana reservation benefits.

content_sections.heading: Application and Examination Fee
content_sections.text: All unemployed applicants are exempted from paying the examination fee of Rs. 120. Employees of the Central Government, State Government, PSUs, corporations and other government-sector organizations must pay the examination fee. The application processing fee is compulsory for all applicants according to their category. Fees must be paid online through Net Banking, debit card, credit card or UPI. Fees once paid will not be refunded or adjusted.

content_sections.heading: TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through an objective written examination conducted in CBRT or OMR mode. Selection will be based on the marks secured in the examination and the applicable reservation rules. Securing the minimum qualifying marks does not automatically provide a right to selection. Final selection will be based on merit, branch-wise vacancies and eligibility verification.

rows.category: SC, ST and Persons with Disabilities

Paper I: General Studies and General Abilities

content_sections.heading: Engineering Subjects Covered in Paper II
content_sections.text: Paper II will be based on the concerned engineering branch at degree level. Separate subject syllabi are provided for: Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Computer Science and Information Technology Electronics and Communication Engineering

content_sections.heading: Examination Centres
content_sections.text: The objective examination is proposed to be held at the following centres: Hyderabad, including HMDA jurisdiction Nalgonda Sangareddy Mahaboobnagar TGPSC may allot candidates to a different centre or add or remove examination centres for administrative reasons. Requests for a change of centre will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official TGPSC website at www.tgpsc.gov.in. Complete One Time Registration if you do not already have a TGPSC ID. Open the online application link for Notification No. 04/OG/HM/2026. Log in using the TGPSC ID, date of birth and OTP received on the registered mobile number. Verify the personal, educational, category and other details fetched from the OTR database. Select the preferred examination centre. Preview the application and check every detail carefully. Click the Save and Payment option and pay the applicable fee online. Click Confirm and Submit to complete the application process. Download the generated PDF application and retain its reference ID for future use.

content_sections.heading: Important Application Instructions
content_sections.text: OTR registration alone is not treated as an application for the post. Candidates must separately submit the online application for this notification. Only the details available in the OTR database at the time of application submission will be considered. Changes made to OTR after submitting the application will not apply to this recruitment. Incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected. Applications submitted through offline or any other mode will not be accepted. Candidates must download and preserve the final PDF application. Applicants must regularly check the TGPSC website for examination and recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 130 Manager (Engineering) vacancies have been announced for Multi Zone II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HMWSSB Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 17 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the TGPSC HMWSSB Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an engineering degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, CSE, IT or ECE, according to the prescribed branch-wise distribution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a TGPSC HMWSSB Manager?
faq.answer: The Manager (Engineering) post carries a pay scale of Rs. 54,220 to Rs. 1,33,630.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for HMWSSB Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on marks obtained in an objective examination conducted through CBRT or OMR mode. The examination consists of General Studies and the concerned engineering subject for a total of 450 marks.
